responsibility: Describes the full set of Nios II target options and their saved state for GCC’s generated option machinery. It defines architecture, endianness, hardware multiply/divide and BMX/CDX feature flags, GP-relative addressing controls, cache-bypass behavior, regex-based section classification, and the large family of per-instruction custom FPU opcode options, creating the target variables and enums that nios2.cc uses to validate capabilities and choose code-generation paths.
same_name_distinction: Within the nios2 same-name set, this file is the option-schema source rather than backend code or RTL descriptions: it declares the target switches, enums, and saved option state that GCC generates into option handling, which nios2.cc then interprets and which complement the architectural defaults in nios2.h.
